Fourth alpha, same day as the third. v0.3.0-alpha shipped the CC/toughness mechanisms; this release is where they (and a big backlog of gameplay requests) actually went live, plus a real visual fix for how the hero and enemies look.

## Play
Download the archive for your OS, unpack, run `ai-evolve` (`ai-evolve.exe` on Windows). The hero is AI-controlled; you are the level director:

- **1 / 2 / 3 / 4** — spawn an enemy / trap / chest / boss near the hero
- **I** — toggle the inventory/skills/stats HUD panels
- **Space / left mouse** — force an attack
- **Esc** — quit

The standalone build starts on the small dev map; run with `--full` for the full-size world. Logs are written to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AI-EVOLVE\output.log` (Windows) or the equivalent user data folder.

## What's new since v0.3.0-alpha
- **Hero and enemies actually look like something now.** They used to be built from 6 flat cards faking a cube; that's now real solid mesh geometry, one shared builder for the hero, enemies and walls. Two real bugs surfaced and got fixed on the way: every box in the game was silently sharing one transform (the last one created anywhere overwrote everyone else's size), and all faces had their triangle winding reversed, so the default back-face culling discarded the mesh -- which is why characters were sometimes invisible depending on camera angle.
- **Crowd control and toughness are live in real combat**, not just a mechanism sitting unused: a few boss abilities now really stun/blind/root/slow, and every landed hit chips away at a poise-style toughness bar (player 100, boss 2000, elite 1500, matching the original numbers) -- break it and the target is stunned 5s and takes 15% more damage for a while.
- **HUD** now has inventory, skills/cooldowns and full current-stats panels (toggle with `I`), plus a proper bordered panel behind the HP/mana/stamina bars instead of bare floating bars.
- **The hero switches to a ranged weapon or skill** when it can't close melee distance, the same way enemies already did.
- **The hero learns physical movement techniques** (roll, jump, sprint, dash) through the same trial-and-reward memory it already used for combat stance, and these (plus heavy attacks and fast ranged shots) cost stamina.
- **The world fills in over time**: 2-3 bosses can be active on a level at once, each periodically calls in reinforcements, and those wander further out the longer they've been around.
- **`scry.py`'s summary now shows what the hero and enemies have learned** (preferred stance/technique per situation, enemy tactics stats), not just combat numbers.
- The old `ai_evolve/`, nested `AI-EVOLVE/` and `game/` code -- superseded duplicates of the CC/toughness/combat systems -- are gone (tagged `archive/pre-legacy-islands` first, fully recoverable from git history). Dead code -36%, tracked LOC -28%.
- `dev_probe.py` is now `scry.py` (`scry_diff.py`); same tool, new name.

## Developer & QA tooling
- `qa.py ctxwatch` -- watches the account's enabled plugins/skills for context-bloat creep across sessions.
- `qa.py check --name standing_context` -- flags it if `CLAUDE.md`/the agent-context docs grow past a size ceiling.
- `qa.py bisect` -- did a working-tree change actually cause an observed gameplay difference, and which file.
- `scry.py --zoom FACTOR` -- a closer debug camera for appearance/model inspection (separate from the normal wide anomaly-hunting view); this is what found the two rendering bugs above.

## Known limitations
- The toughness elemental-effectiveness matrix (fire vs ice, etc.) is intentionally neutral for now -- porting the old numbers onto the current damage types is a balance decision that needs a real design pass, not a mechanical port.
- There is still no scene lighting (ambient/directional) anywhere -- the new solid geometry has correct face normals but nothing to shade it with yet, so it currently renders flat/unlit. Real per-face shading is the natural next visual step.
- Same platform note as earlier alphas: gameplay golden scenarios were recorded on Linux, so a Windows dev run shows expected (not bug) differences; CI is the source of truth.
